message.Title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB System Managed Maintenance Window

Body.Content:
Azure HorizonDB supports system-managed maintenance for planned service upgrades.With system-managed maintenance, Azure HorizonDB automatically performs planned upgrades on your cluster without requiring you to configure or manage a maintenance schedule.

This helps keep your cluster secure, reliable, and up to date while reducing the operational overhead of managing routine service maintenance.

Learn more.
